description: We are team of six who graduted from KAUST and would love to try and have fun through this hakathon
summary:
- Project: SPHEREx Change Detector
- Goal: Find objects that move, change brightness, or appear briefly in repeated telescope images.
- How it works: The system aligns images of the same sky area, identifies possible changes, and combines image patterns with brightness history to rank alerts for review.
- Deliverables: Dataset, trained models, code, evaluation notebook, and ranked alerts.
details:
- Smaller review queue: On eight test fields, the system narrowed 117,825 candidate signals to 4,542 alerts. Reviewing 3.85% of candidates captured 74.04% of labelled changes.

- Better than the previous model: Recall rose from 63.35% to 74.04%, while precision rose from 79.86% to 80.69%.

- Strongest on moving objects: It identified 118 of 127 simulated moving objects at least once. Brief events were harder, with 7 of 76 recovered.

- PlanetX Repair v1 follow-up: In a separate experiment, simulated motion detection improved from 50% to 75% in SPHEREx and from 3% to 25% in WISE. The repair generated about 10× as many alerts on real SPHEREx images, and its top 93 alerts missed all 42 known target sightings. Better alert ranking is the priority before deployment.
